name: Michael Doyle
role: prospector, one of the gulch's discoverers
want: see his sister and her boys safe, and turn the gulch into a town before anyone else finds it
secret: The gold in the creek is thinning; the rich ground may be the quartz up the ridge, and he hasn't told his partner.
voice: Boston Irish like his sister, louder.
description: Martha's younger brother, who came west for the Montana gold and drifted south with a partner. He wrote to his sister because she is the one person he trusts.
appearance: Ragged, sunburnt, a beard full of gravel dust, a grin that hasn't changed since he was ten.
